messages:
Maria_CS: Customer reported 422 from /v1/rerank, says all candidate scores are 0. They pasted a payload that worked previously but fails now.
Shawn_Eng: Can you drop the original payload (sanitized) + exact curl/SDK call?
Maria_CS: Pasting sanitized payload now. Note they send a top-level 'query' and each candidate has its own 'query' field for contextual scoring.
Maria_CS: ```json
{
  "query": "Who founded Redwood?",
  "documents": [ { "id": "doc1", "text": "Redwood was founded by..." } ],
  "candidates": [
    { "id": "c1", "text": "Sam Altman", "query": "founder hint" },
    { "id": "c2", "text": "Other Person", "query": "founder hint" }
  ]
}
```
Maria_CS: Server responds with 422 payload validation error: "ambiguous query field: multiple query fields found" (customer copied).
Shawn_Eng: Hmm, we shouldn't error on nested 'query' inside candidate objects — historically candidate-level context was allowed (but not named query). Could be recent strict parser update.
Liang_ML: The rerank parser expects candidate-level context under 'metadata' or 'ctx' not 'query'. If both top-level and nested 'query' present the validator treats nested as conflicting key path, which can set scores to 0 if parsing fails.
Sam_PM: Did we ship any change to the schema validation recently?
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T09:12:03 by ci/canary: service-reranker-schema-validator v1.4.0 -> v1.5.0
Shawn_Eng: That deploy updated our JSON Schema to be stricter about duplicate 'query' keys. We probably introduced regression.
Maria_CS: Customer says this used to work; they can't refactor quickly. They want a workaround and ETA.
Shawn_Eng: Short-term workaround: rename candidate-level 'query' to 'candidate_query' or move it under 'metadata' and send top-level 'query' only. I'll add a note to support reply.
Liang_ML: I'll reproduce locally: craft payload with nested 'query' and run our validator binary. I suspect it returns 'ambiguous key' and then our reranker falls back to zero scores.
Shawn_Eng: Filing internal bug and rollback candidate: RERANK-3281. Assigning to infra. For now we should also make error message actionable: tell user to avoid nested 'query' key or use 'candidate_query' + provide example.
Maria_CS: Sending suggested reply to customer: short example and quick explanation.
Maria_CS: ```json
{
  "query": "Who founded Redwood?",
  "documents": [ { "id": "doc1", "text": "Redwood..." } ],
  "candidates": [ { "id": "c1", "text": "Sam Altman", "metadata": { "hint": "founder" } } ]
}
```
Sam_PM: We should also add a note in the docs about reserved top-level keys and nested field naming conventions. Add to the API breaking-changes checklist before any schema tightening.
deploy-bot: Created issue infra/RERANK-3281 and linked canary logs: https://internal.short/link/infra/RERANK-3281
Shawn_Eng: Status update: reproduced locally, validator rejects nested 'query'. Patch queued to relax validator to allow nested 'query' inside objects but we will prefer 'metadata' in docs. If rollback needed, we can revert v1.5.0.
Maria_CS: I'll follow up with customer and offer immediate workaround + ETA for fix.
Liang_ML: After patch we should add an explicit unit test for nested keys and add helpful error text: 'Detected nested key "query" inside candidates; rename to "metadata.query" or "candidate_query"' to avoid confusion.
Maria_CS: Thanks everyone, I'll close the escalation once customer confirms workaround works. :thumbsup:
